findings: YES misfires: 22 of the 46 comments that fired the flow (47.8%) were praise, like 'yes!! so true', so those people got a DM they never asked for. Across all comments read, 'yes' has a 63.4% misfire share.
The biggest drop is from openers to answers: 50.0% (23 of 46). It follows from the misfires: people who didn't ask don't tap.
The nudge breaks the 24-hour window (26 hours after the tap) and its link is untagged, so its 2 clicks can't be seen in GA4: the dm- campaign shows 18 sessions against 22 DM clicks.
16 people asked for the template on the flow post without typing YES ('can I get the policy doc?', 'would love the template'), so the flow never answered them.
Leads can't be traced to the DM in Klaviyo: none of the 61 profiles that joined since launch carries a dm- source, and the DM never asks for the email.
